'''Black Battalion''' was a military unit in the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it was commanded by Captain [[Eligyn]] and stationed inside the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. When [[Empire's Wrath|the Sith apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] arrived to eliminate Commander [[Rylon (spy)|Rylon]], Black Battalion attempted to stop the Sith, but was wiped out.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Black Battalion appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Warrior class mission on Balmorra.<ref name="SWTOR" />
